# FDG8094

> DO call the `Uri`-based overloads, if available.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.11.1 System.Uri Implementation Guidelines.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA2234
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

The text has no body. CA2234 reports a call that passes a string to a parameter whose name contains a word such as uri or url when an overload takes System.Uri in that position (probe with SDK 10.0.402). Overloads whose string parameter has another name, such as WebClient.DownloadString(string address), are not seen, so coverage is partial. CA2234 has no code fix.
